description: This file defines the interface for remote connections within the WPEFramework RPC namespace, including the IRemoteConnection interface, its nested INotification interface, and iterator type definitions for strings and uint32_t. It includes licensing information, include directives, and namespace encapsulation.

classes.name: IRemoteConnection
classes.description: Interface representing a remote connection with methods for managing connection state and acquiring interfaces.

classes.name: IRemoteConnection::INotification
classes.description: Nested interface for remote connection event notifications such as activation, deactivation, and termination.

methods.name: IRemoteConnection::Id
methods.description: Returns the identifier of the remote connection.

methods.name: IRemoteConnection::RemoteId
methods.description: Returns the remote identifier associated with the connection.

methods.name: IRemoteConnection::Acquire
methods.description: Acquires an interface pointer based on class name, interface ID, and version, with a wait time.

methods.name: IRemoteConnection::PostMortem
methods.description: Performs post-mortem diagnostics on the connection.
